stages.reference: Create a close material reference for forest-green stained glass whose old mineral pigment lends it a faint olive undertone. The body feels like aged bottle glass in flat architectural form: light travels through a subdued green silica mass, deepening gently where the glass is thick. Hand forming leaves slight unevenness but no dominant surface pattern. Weathering is subtle, producing quiet dullness rather than moss growing across the glass. Keep the green earthy and readable in a dark-fantasy building material, with soft diffuse illumination and natural optical depth. Avoid emerald gemstones, fluorescent green, vines, painted leaves, reflective bottles, mosaic designs, large fractures or opaque forest scenery. The matching detail component belongs to the same batch of glass.
